description: 2022 Noise Data is a dataset listed in BTS National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD) on geodata.bts.gov, an open geospatial hub of the U.S. transportation atlas, published or maintained by Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS). The 2022 National Transportation Noise Map dataset utilized transportation mode data from 2022 (aviation and rail) and 2023 (roads) to model transportation noise at the national level and was released in May 2026 published by the Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS), and is part of the U.S. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS). Its keywords are environment, USA, National, Hawaii, HI, Alaska, AK, CONUS. The hub shows 2026-06-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, not copyrighted, unrestricted public use (as stated on the hub). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ntad-geodata-bts-gov-hub.
